links.comparator_used: Unmodified RetCAD with the manufacturer's default DR score cut-offs, compared with a threshold set on local data (Youden-index-adjusted, and the 'Greifswald modification' referral threshold of DR score >0.1)
links.outcome: Sensitivity for more than mild DR, and number of severe and moderate DR cases missed
links.effect: Diagnosable patients: sensitivity for more than mild DR rose from 70.41% (unmodified) to 86.89% (Youden-adjusted) and 93.63% (Greifswald). All patients: 60.06% to 74.14% to 79.87%. Severe DR missed: 13 (unmodified), 8 (Youden-adjusted), 2 (Greifswald). Moderate DR missed: 67 (unmodified) vs 13 (Greifswald).
links.tradeoff: Specificity fell: 93.86% to 82.67% (Youden) to 69.06% (Greifswald) in diagnosable patients, and 90.38% to 79.62% to 66.5% in all patients. The reduction in ophthalmologist exams shrank from 78.49% to 67.13% to 55.36%. The threshold was derived on a single-centre population and may not transfer to other populations.
links.quote: Under this scenario, 2 severe DR cases and 13 moderate DR cases would be missed compared to 13 severe DR and 67 moderate DR cases with unmodified RetCAD screening.
